props.name: items
props.description:
List of errors of type `ErrorItem`.
If element id is unspecified, no link will be rendered.
If element with id don't exist on navigation, an exception is thrown.

props.name: beforeNavigate
props.description: Optional callback for performing actions before navigation.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Optional title shown above the errorlist. No icon is shown if no title is set
